title: HSM generator configuration (hsm.gen.json)
description: Which state machine models (.hsm) are generated for which targets with which options. Used by `hsm generate` and the CMake function hsm_generate. Relative paths are relative to the configuration file.

models.description: Paths or globs (`*`, `?`, `**`) of .hsm files, optionally with options overriding the target options for these models (applied in order).

writeOnlyIfChanged.description: Only write files whose content changed, keeping the modification time of the others so that build systems do not recompile them (default: true).

headers.description: Analysis of imported C/C++ headers (import "motor_types.h" in a model, see docs/cpp-integration.md). Used by hsm (CLI), the language server of the VS Code extension (the nearest configuration above a model) and the generator.

includePaths.description: Include directories (relative to the configuration file), searched after the directory of the model for imported headers and for the #includes of headers (like -I).

defines.description: Predefined macros for #if / #ifdef in the headers (like -D): "NAME": "value", "" for a macro without value.

dataModel.description: Data model of the target, e.g. { "longBits": 32, "pointerBits": 32 } for 32-bit microcontrollers (default: LP64 as on Linux x86-64, signed char).

pointerBits.description: Bits of pointers, size_t, ptrdiff_t, intptr_t (default: 64).

charSigned.description: Whether plain char is signed (default: true).

outDir.description: Output directory, relative to the configuration file (default: the directory of each model). hsm generate --out and hsm_generate(OUTPUT_DIR) override it.

headerExtension.description: Extension of the generated headers, including the dot (default: .h). The includes of the generated files are adapted.

licenseHeader.description: Text put at the top of every generated file (a string or an array of lines). Wrapped in a /* */ comment unless it starts with // or /*.

licenseHeaderFile.description: File (relative to the configuration file) whose text is used as licenseHeader.

maxMicrosteps.description: Maximum number of transitions per step and of queued event steps per call (default: 1000).

cpp.description: Generate C++ (a class per state machine plus the runtime header sc_statemachine.h).

namespace.description: Namespace of the generated classes, e.g. app::sm (default: the namespace of the model; "": the global namespace).

className.description: Name of the class and its files (default: the state machine name). Only useful in the options of a single model.

std.description: C++ standard the code is written for (default: 17).

sourceExtension.description: Extension of the generated sources, including the dot (default: .cpp).

c.description: Generate C99 (a .h / .c pair per state machine plus sc_types.h).

prefix.description: Prefix of the functions and file names (default: the state machine name in snake case). Only useful in the options of a single model.

typeName.description: Name of the handle type (default: the state machine name).

stringCapacity.description: Size of string buffers including the terminating 0 (default: 64).

queueCapacity.description: Capacity of the event queues of event driven machines (default: 16).

sourceExtension.description: Extension of the generated sources, including the dot (default: .c).
